reason: The chat routing step (_stream_tool_turn with tool_choice=required and finish_response) failed the whole turn whenever a model deviated slightly, where opencode, the AI SDK, Codex, Cline and pi-mono keep going. Live evidence: GLM via OpenRouter writing prose beside its tool calls (chat.routing.prose_with_required_tool) and finish_response called with arguments. The audit also verified that a hallucinated or budget-spent tool, a reused provider call id (Gemini's synthetic ids repeat across responses without responseId), and a route rejecting tool_choice=required each failed the turn, while a call cut off by the output limit executed with truncated arguments. Now: prose beside calls becomes streamed and stored thinking and the calls run, text or an unreadable control frame with no call finishes through synthesis, both recorded as a WARNING that keeps the protected provider-response capture (diagnostics now captures explicit sensitive detail for a warning that names its own error id); finish_response arguments are ignored with only their keys recorded; unknown, budget-spent and output-limit-truncated calls become failed, non-charging steps whose result tells the model what to do, without reaching the broker, capped at three consecutive deviating routing responses before synthesis; a reused id runs under a Core-owned id unless it replays a call that already ran, which is answered from history so no effect repeats; a 400 naming tool_choice retries the step with auto for the rest of the turn; the capability probe accepts a preamble beside its one structured call; tool_catalog.unwrap_call keeps flattened arguments and reports non-object arguments as _unparsed_arguments; and Gemini ids are scoped per response. tests/v3/test_chat_routing_tolerance.py and tests/v3/test_gemini_call_ids.py are new (all but two guard tests fail on main), the listed test_chat_tool_loop, test_tool_catalog and test_provider_verification node ids were edited or added and fail on main, and the remaining node ids exercise the changed routing batch, Gemini complete() and sensitive-detail capture directly.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/chat.py, api.py, providers.py, diagnostics.py and tool_catalog.py) does not exercise deviating routing responses, Gemini ids without responseId or the capability probe's preamble; the Python tests drive them directly. The broader chat, provider, diagnostics, catalog and subagent files were run locally, not in CI. No full suites.
